fs-lost-stay.back: It reduces the time and the area searchers must cover.

fs-lost-area.front: You wander twice as far. How much bigger is the search area?
fs-lost-area.back: 4 times. Area grows with the distance squared.
fs-lost-area.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Search area grows fast: wander 1 kilometre and the search circle has some area; wander 2 kilometres and the circle is 4 times bigger. Double the distance, 4 times the area.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Every km you wander, they search more</text><circle cx="120" cy="160" r="30.0" fill="#cfe0ef" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="120" cy="160" r="4.0" fill="#e8590c"/><text x="120" y="214" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">1 km out</text><text x="120" y="234" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">area x 1</text><circle cx="290" cy="160" r="60.0" fill="#cfe0ef" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="290" cy="160" r="4.0" fill="#e8590c"/><text x="290" y="244" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">2 km out</text><text x="290" y="264" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">area x 4</text><text x="200" y="290" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Double the distance: 4 times the area</text>
</svg>

fs-lost-circle.front: Can you walk straight in thick timber under cloud?
fs-lost-circle.back: Usually not. Studies show people curve and even cross their own path without sun or landmarks.

fs-lost-downhill.front: Lost in steep country: follow the creek downhill?
fs-lost-downhill.back: Not by default. Creeks drop into ravines and canyons that are hard to climb out of.

fs-lost-first.front: First action when you need rescue?
fs-lost-first.back: Call 911. Police dispatch Search and Rescue.

  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>

</svg>

fs-lost-tower.front: Your carrier has no signal. Can 911 still connect?
fs-lost-tower.back: Often yes, through any carrier tower in range.

fs-lost-say.front: On the call, what do you say first?

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Call step 2: read your GPS coordinates from the phone and give them first. Turn on location services before the trip.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">2. </svg>

fs-lost-sos.front: No signal at all. What next?
fs-lost-sos.back: Satellite SOS (iPhone 14 or later in Canada, or a satellite messenger) from open sky.

fs-lost-phone.front: Where does the phone ride in the cold, and why?
fs-lost-phone.back: Inside pocket against your body. Cold drains batteries and can shut the phone off (iPhone range 0 to 35 °C).
fs-lost-phone.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Cold kills phone batteries: a phone in an outer pack pocket gets cold and shuts down; a phone in an inside jacket pocket stays warm and lasts. Apple lists 0 to 35 degrees Celsius as the operating range.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Cold kills phone batteries</text><rect x="60" y="60" width="60" height="120" rx="10" fill="#2f3a2b"/><rect x="68" y="70" width="44" height="22" rx="2" fill="#c0392b"/><text x="90" y="210" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Pack pocket</text><text x="90" y="230" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">cold, dies</text><rect x="280" y="60" width="60" height="120" rx="10" fill="#2f3a2b"/><rect x="288" y="70" width="44" height="80" rx="2" fill="#2e7d32"/><text x="310" y="210" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Inside jacket</text><text x="310" y="230" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="middle">warm, lasts</text><text x="200" y="120" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">vs</text><rect x="41" y="252" width="317" height="30" rx="6" fill="#2f3a2b"/><text x="200" y="273" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">iPhone works best from 0 to 35 °C</text>

</svg>

fs-lost-v.front: Ground to air signal and size?
fs-lost-v.back: A V or SOS at least 3 m long, high contrast.

fs-lost-found.front: Three ways to help searchers find you?
fs-lost-found.back: Settle at the edge of an opening, spread orange and bright gear, whistle 3 times when you hear them.

fs-lost-whistle.front: Why a whistle instead of shouting?
fs-lost-whistle.back: It carries farther and costs no energy.

fs-lost-lookback.front: Best habit to avoid getting lost?
fs-lost-lookback.back: Pin the truck, look back at every junction, carry map and compass, set a turn back time.
